factoryData.name: celebamask-hq
factoryData.shortDescription: Mask-guided face editing (MaskGAN): edit the 19-class face mask -> regenerate the face
factoryData.description: RESTRICTED. Must not reach apps/ or any shipped artifact. Enforced in code: blocks/face_editor is unavailable unless FACTORY_ALLOW_NONCOMMERCIAL=1, and build() returns the mock instead. Repo ships code only; the generator (latest_net_G.pth) is distributed separately. Cite Lee et al., CVPR 2020.

localOverrides.description: Explores mask-guided facial editing with CelebAMask-HQ and MaskGAN while documenting the dataset's noncommercial licensing restrictions.
